summary: First full run on ITALIACORSI CRM. Backend: 18/18 pytest pass (/app/backend/tests/test_crm_api.py, run with -n 0) covering role enforcement (401/403), POST /persons duplicate 409 + force, leads webhook (secret, create da_assegnare + 'Contatto ricevuto' deal, duplicate merge by +39 phone), take/409 on second take, activities CRUD + period filters + counts, pipeline + PATCH fase history, contratti webhook (401 wrong secret, fase events, non-fase events logged, motivo_perso), full mock contratti flow (anteprima, create draft/invia, invia 409, reinvia, promemoria PATCH, proroga validation, LMS 409 before accepted, fattura 404 before paid, simula apertura/promemoria/accettata/pagamento x3 rate/perso, deal fase sync, fattura_emessa log), import persons/orgs/deals/activities/notes with pipedrive_id dedupe, cron 401, 7 active products, admin delete. Frontend (Clerk ticket sign-in as Angelo admin and Luca commerciale): contacts table, create-person live duplicate warning, deep link + full reload on /contatti/da-assegnare and /attivita WORK (no redirect to /contatti), Prendo io, labels picker, edit person, add note, activity form (type buttons, quick presets, mini day calendar follows date), planned activity quick reschedule, timeline tabs, Crea proposta -> anteprima (sotto minimo warning) -> Crea e invia -> sheet panel; simulate buttons, LMS, 3 installments paid -> fattura link, deal fase select updates (Proposta inviata -> Aggiudicato). Affari kanban drag&drop works and list view; Attivita filters/mark done/Richiama; Import CSV parse+auto-mapping+import (Creati 2); Utenti role change persists after reload; Collegamenti shows secrets/products; global search; sign-out returns to /sign-in. Commerciale UI hides admin nav/delete button and /importa shows admin-only message. No functional bugs found; only minor issues below.

minor.issue: Deals of the deleted person are kept with person_id=None and keep showing in pipeline/kanban as orphan cards ('—'). Linked mock_proposte also remain. Decide: delete deals or block deletion/ask in confirm.

Fase events are applied regardless of current fase, so a late/out-of-order 'remind_inviato' or 'proposta_inviata' moves an Aggiudicato/Perso deal backwards. Consider ignoring regressions from closed deals.
valore parsing: '1.500' (Italian thousands without comma) becomes 1.5; only strings containing ',' get thousands-dot stripping.
_clerk_profile uses blocking requests.get inside async dependency; wrap in run_in_threadpool.
On duplicate match only label/log/new deal are added; new info from the lead (e.g. email when matched by phone, professione, citta) is discarded.
Proposal id derived from count_documents()+1 -> race/duplicate ids under concurrent creation.
Secret also accepted via ?key= query param (leaks into access logs). Optional hardening.

ui_bugs.issue: No loading state: board/list render empty (and '0 affari') until /deals/pipeline resolves
del() handlers have no try/catch -> unhandled rejection with no toast on API error

issues: Sonner toasts top-right cover the header user menu/role badge and the ProposalPanel sheet close (X) button
Native browser date/time/datetime-local pickers used (activity form, person primo contatto, proposal scadenza/proroga, promemoria) instead of shadcn Calendar
Console a11y warning: DialogContent without DialogTitle (Radix)
Scadenza shown as ISO '2026-11-05' and amounts '€ 894.00' – use Italian formatting (05/11/2026, € 894,00)
Icon-only nav without visible labels; ensure tooltips/title for discoverability

action_items: Decide behaviour of orphan deals when a person is deleted (delete deals or warn)
Prevent backward fase moves from contratti webhook on closed deals
Fix Italian number parsing in deal import ('1.500')
Add loading state to Kanban/List and try/catch on delete handlers
Move toaster position or offset so it doesn't cover header/sheet close button; consider shadcn date pickers; Italian date/amount formatting in proposal email
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1476 lines – split into routers (persons, deals, activities, webhooks, import, contratti, products)
PersonDetail ActivityRow 'late' uses UTC date (new Date().toISOString()) vs backend Europe/Rome – mismatch around midnight

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (minor design issues only)

test_credentials: Per /app/memory/test_credentials.md: angelo+clerk_test (admin), luca/carla+clerk_test (commerciale), nuovo+clerk_test (in_attesa). Tokens via tests/make_test_users.py; UI ticket via `python tests/make_ticket.py [Angelo|Luca|Carla|Nuovo]`.
seed_data_creation: All TEST_ data cleaned up (persons, deals, orgs). DB back to only 'Mario Rossi'. mock_proposte from test runs remain (PR-2026-000x). Nuovo role restored to in_attesa.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `cd /app/backend && python tests/make_test_users.py && python -m pytest tests/test_crm_api.py -n 0` (pytest.ini enables xdist; tests share state so must be serial). UI login: `python tests/make_ticket.py Angelo` -> open <preview>/sign-in?__clerk_ticket=<t>, wait for [data-testid=sidebar]. Tickets are single-use. Not tested: /api/cron/sync-prodotti with valid WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET (not readable without opening .env), in_attesa waiting UI, org detail page, CSV import of deals/activities/notes via UI (API tested).
rca of the issue: Deep link concern from main agent not reproduced: after ticket sign-in, page.goto + reload on /contatti/da-assegnare and /attivita stay on the deep link.
